newsitem.title: USA: Washington Nat'l said exploring sale of co.
newsitem.headline: Washington Nat'l said exploring sale of co.

text.p: Life insurer Washington National Corp, which has a market value of about $345 million, is exploring a possible sale of the company, people familiar with the situation said.
The Lincolnshire, Ill.-based insurer has hired Morgan Stanley as its investment banker and has opened its books to prospective buyers, they said.
Washington National has declined to comment.
Sources said several parties have expressed interest in the company, but they declined to identify them.

Industry sources said possible suitors could include Conseco Inc, Jefferson-Pilot Corp and Equitable Cos Inc, as well as some moderate-sized insurers that have not yet been active players in the industry's consolidation, such as ReliaStar Financial Corp.
ReliaStar said it was always in the process of reviewing possible acquisition candidates, but said it had no comment on Washington National in particular.
Conseco, Jefferson-Pilot and Equitable declined comment.
But one source said the company may attract separate buyers for its annuity and life businesses.
Washington National closed unchanged at 28-3/8. to
The possible sale of the company comes less than three months after the company agreed to sell off two pieces of its business.
In early August, Washington National completed the sale of a block of individual and small group health insurance businesses to Pioneer Financial Services Inc.
